correctness.rationale: A 29-by-28 jet matrix has exact rank 27. The associated sextic has Groebner elimination y(5y+3)^5/3125, with specialized common x-root supports precisely P11 and Q0; z=0 supplies only P1 and P3. All tangent cones are squarefree; a Bezout argument and four exact line substitutions prove absolute irreducibility. Relative blow-up smoothness extends the complete singularity basket to a dense Zariski open. Genus ten minus deltas 3+6 equals one, and the polar class gives 30-6-12=12. SymPy checker rerun from included exact path.
